Severe Weather Warning for Furneaux Islands, North West Coast, Central North, North East, Midlands, South East, Central Plateau, Western
warnings.desc: DAMAGING WINDS averaging 60 to 70 km/h with peak gusts in excess of 100 km/h are occurring in the southwest and northeast (including the Furneaux Islands) this morning, extending to parts of the Midlands, Western Tiers and exposed southeast by mid to late morning. Conditions ease across the southwest, northeast and Furneaux Islands around lunch time, and the remainder of the warning area by late afternoon. Locations which may be affected include Strahan, Oatlands, Whitemark, Bridport and Strathg
